transcript.text:
Here are the API calls, in order, to create, activate, and retrieve results from a certification campaign.

---

## Step 1: Authenticate — Get an Access Token

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/oauth/token' \
  --form 'grant_type="client_credentials"' \
  --form 'client_id="{clientId}"' \
  --form 'client_secret="{clientSecret}"'
```

Use the returned `access_token` as a Bearer token in all subsequent calls.

---

## Step 2: Create the Campaign

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "Q3 Access Review",
    "description": "Quarterly manager certification campaign",
    "type": "MANAGER",
    "correlatedStatus": "CORRELATED"
  }'
```

Save the `id` from the response — you need it for the next steps. For search-based campaigns (Identities, Access Items, etc.), include a `filter` object in the body. For a Source Owner campaign, include `sourceOwnerCampaignInfo`.

---

## Step 3: Activate the Campaign

Once you've previewed and confirmed the campaign, activate it:

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

This moves the campaign from preview/pending into an active state where reviewers can begin certifying access.

---

## Step 4: Check Campaign Status

```bash
curl -X GET \
  'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'
```

The `status` field will reflect the current state (e.g., `ACTIVE`, `COMPLETED`, `IN_REMEDIATION`).

---

## Step 5: Pull Campaign Reports

```bash
curl -X GET \
  'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'
```

This returns available report types. To run and download a specific report:

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports/{type}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}'
```

Where `{type}` is something like `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION` or `CERTIFICATION_DECISIONS`.

---

## Flow Summary

| # | Call | Purpose |
|---|------|---------|
| 1 | `POST /oauth/token` | Get bearer token |
| 2 | `POST /v3/campaigns` | Create the campaign |
| 3 | `POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/activate` | Start it |
| 4 | `GET /v3/campaigns/{id}` | Check status |
| 5 | `GET /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports` | List available reports |
| 6 | `POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports/{type}` | Run/download a report |
